title: Detailed kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 82 Q46 88 42 92 Q38 96 34 98' stroke='#f0c040' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 81 Q54 86 52 90 Q56 92 54 96 Q58 96 60 99' stroke='#40c0f0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <path d='M52 89 L48 87 L48 91 Z' fill='#f05090'/>
  <path d='M54 95 L50 93 L50 97 Z' fill='#f05090'/>
  <!-- kite diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,10 80,48 50,82 20,48' fill='#ff4040' stroke='#ff8080' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- horizontal spar -->
  <line x1='20' y1='48' x2='80' y2='48' stroke='#ffcccc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- vertical spar -->
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#ffcccc' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- upper left panel accent -->
  <polygon points='50,10 65,29 50,29' fill='#ffb040'/>
  <!-- upper right panel accent -->
  <polygon points='50,10 65,29 50,29' fill='#ffd060' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- right panel accent -->
  <polygon points='80,48 65,29 50,29 50,48' fill='#ff7040' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- lower left panel accent -->
  <polygon points='20,48 35,29 50,29 50,48' fill='#ff6060'/>
  <!-- lower right panel accent -->
  <polygon points='80,48 65,67 50,48' fill='#ff9060'/>
  <!-- lower left deeper accent -->
  <polygon points='20,48 35,67 50,48' fill='#ff5050'/>
  <!-- decorative dots on panels -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2.5' fill='#ffff80'/>
  <!-- extra small diamond detail -->
  <polygon points='50,20 58,29 50,38 42,29' fill='none' stroke='#ffdddd' stroke-width='1'/>
  <polygon points='50,52 58,61 50,70 42,61' fill='none' stroke='#ffdddd' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
